props.title: Garden of the Gods Resort and Club
props.lede: Garden of the Gods Resort looks out over the red rocks of Garden of the Gods and up to Pikes Peak. It was a private club for decades, and it’s one of the most beautiful places in Colorado for a wedding.

headingText.html: It has seven event spaces with five terraces and lawns between them, and most of them look right at the rocks.

props.title: Event spaces at Garden of the Gods Resort

rows.text: The Three Graces Ballroom is about 3,400 sq ft, for 220 to 300 guests. It has a glass-walled foyer and a private terrace with fire and water features.
The View at Kissing Camels is about 2,700 sq ft, for 130 to 150 guests, looking out over the golf course, Pikes Peak and the red rocks.
The Garden Room is a ballroom with windows, about 1,900 sq ft, for 100 to 150 guests, and it can be divided.
The Hill Room is round, with picture windows facing the rocks and the mountains, for 40 to 60 guests.
The Reflection Pool is the resort’s main outdoor ceremony site, for up to 220 guests seated.

props.title: Live music for a ceremony at the Reflection Pool
props.lede: It’s the resort’s favorite spot for a ceremony, with the red rocks behind you.

props.title: Live music in the Three Graces Ballroom and on the terraces
props.lede: They’re the spaces for the cocktail hour and the reception.

props.title: Live music at the View and the Hill Room
props.lede: They’re lovely for rehearsal dinners, client dinners and small receptions.

rows.text: Our acts bring their own sound system, sized to the space. The resort also has full AV support for events.
Every wedding has a planner or coordinator, and we plan load-in and setup with them and the resort’s sales and catering team.
The resort caters events in-house, and the reception includes a dance floor.
The Reflection Pool and the terraces are outdoors, and the resort offers backup space for an outdoor ceremony.
There’s complimentary valet and self-parking at the resort.

props.title: Ask about your date at Garden of the Gods Resort.
props.lede: Send us your date, and we can put together live music for your wedding or event at the resort, from strings at the Reflection Pool to a band in the Three Graces Ballroom.
